Hotend calibration

Measure temperature tracking under flow, then heating and cooling response.

Printer connection
No automatic connection on launch.
Live calibration: Moonraker / Klipper on Windows. Configure the selected tool's heater, part fan and selection method. Calibrate tools one at a time; each has independent results. Printing, paused and active SD jobs block calibration commands. The runner checks reported firmware heater/extrusion limits.
